To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The entrepreneurial intention of the bank employees in Lebanon are affected by desirability, creativity, and feasibility.
The perceived desirability and feasibility of the entrepreneurial activity and creativity of employees have significant effect on their entrepreneurial intention.
perceived feasibility, perceived desirability and creative thinking are the main determinants of the entrepreneurial intention among employees.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the entrepreneurial intention of employees in Lebanon and how perceived desirabilities, perceived feasibility and perceived creativity affect the entrepreneurial intention of bank's employees.

the impact of perceived desirability (i.e. the extent to which employees perceive that they would like to be entrepreneurs and that entrepreneurship is personally desirable), perceived feasibility (i.e. employees' perceptions of their ability to start a new venture) and creativity (i.e. employee's creativity in terms of their ability to think of new and innovative ideas) on employees' entrepreneurial intention (i.e. their willingness to engage into entrepreneurship in future instead of working for an organization) in the Lebanese context.
the impact of perceived desirability and perceived feasibility on entrepreneurial intention.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the study has successfully achieved its objectives and has contributed to the literature by identifying the factors which have an influence on the entrepreneurial intention among bank employees.
the perceived desirability has the highest impact on the entrepreneurial intention among bank employees in Lebanon.
the perceived desirability of the employees is the most important factor in determining entrepreneurial intention, followed by perceived feasibility, and creativity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our study is a first attempt in Lebanon to measure the impact of desirability, creativity and feasibility on the entrepreneurial intention of employees.

the study is the first one that investigates the relationship between perceived desirability and feasibility of entrepreneurship, and creativity and entrepreneurial intention among bank employees in Lebanon.
the study has provided an understanding about the impact of perceived feasibility, desirabilty and creativity on the intention of the employees in Lebanon to engage in entrepreneurial behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that
bank employees are willing to become entrepreneurs and that they have a positive intention of becoming entrepreneurs.
the bank management should take into consideration the importance of creativity, feasibility and desirabilty of employees to increase their entrepreneurial intentions.
the perceived desirability is the most influential predictor on entrepreneurial intention, followed by perceived feasibility and creativity.
